subject: Weekend invoice used old exchange rate

messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: An EUR invoice we made on Sunday used Friday's rate.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: That's BUG-2000-03: rates aren't refreshed on weekends on 2.0.0. It's fixed in 2.0.1. You can edit the rate on the invoice.

messages.name: Nakatomi Trading admin
messages.body: That's not great, but we'll use the workaround.
